Name: MULTI_PLAY_CORRECTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the adjustments to apply to client players during a multiplayer session.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1 Co-op Client
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when there is 1 co-op client. In Elden Ring this is applied to the enemy; likely the same here.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 2 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when there are 2 co-op clients. In Elden Ring this is applied to the enemy; likely the same here.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 3 Co-op Clients
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when there are 3 co-op clients. In Elden Ring this is applied to the enemy; likely the same here.

Fields.Name: Adjust SpEffects on Client Count Change
Fields.Description: If ON, the SpEffect is overwritten when the number of co-op players changes.
